headline: Updates on shellfish enforcement and restoration, North Shore Shellfish Network, and raising the commercial permit daily catch limit.
summary: The meeting covers updates on enforcement, management, and restoration efforts from the Shellfish Constable. It also includes a discussion with UMass Amherst Gloucester Marine Station members about the North Shore Shellfish Network and a discussion on raising the commercial permit daily catch limit.
items: Updates on enforcement, management and restoration efforts, Shellfish Constable
Discussion with members from UMass Amherst Gloucester Marine Station about the North Shore Shellfish Network
Discussion on raising the commercial permit daily catch limit
location: Harbormaster's Conference Room, 19 Harbor Loop, Gloucester, MA 01930
